title: A.R.M.O.R. state of a Zigbee sensor, told to the panel of an alarm node
description: What the server tells an ARMOR-NODE-ALARM panel about the Zigbee sensor linked to one of its zones, on armor/alarm/{node_id}/zigbee (never retained), while the server holds the Zigbee radio: the zone, whether its sensor is normal, triggered or tampered with, and whether its battery is low. It is information towards the panel and never a command: it cannot arm, disarm or sound anything by itself. The node of the topic is the panel's; the message does not repeat it. When the server signs its zone messages (the setting server.zone_feed_signature), the message also carries seq, a number that only goes up (the server's time in milliseconds), and sig, the HMAC-SHA256 in hex over node_id|zone|state|battery_low (1 or 0)|seq with the key of the panel; the two come together or not at all, and a panel that holds its key refuses a message whose signature is wrong or whose seq is not above the last one it accepted.
